page: Amazon Web Services r9g.48xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors built on the arm64 architecture. The instance features 192 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, providing a consistent ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, which offloads virtualization functions to dedicated hardware to maximize resource availability for workloads. It does not include local NVMe storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64-based Graviton architecture offers a high density of physical cores and memory capacity, optimizing resource allocation for large-scale deployments without the overhead of hyperthreading. The r9g.48xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, real-time big data analytics, and enterprise-grade applications requiring substantial memory footprints and high network throughput.
